title: ampliglossum bifolium

It is a flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family, known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. The twin-leaved orchid has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues.
